newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: United Distillers launches new Irish spirit.
newsitem.headline: United Distillers launches new Irish spirit.

text.p: United Distillers on Wednesday launched a new spirit based on an old Irish recipe for poitin (poteen) or moonshine whisky which has been illegally distilled in Ireland for over 300 years.
Hackler Irish Poitin, is a pure, high quality alcohol whose production, unlike that of its precursor, has been approved by the Irish Revenue Commissioners.
